title: VLSM Address Plan Fault Investigation
summary: Investigate and resolve Variable Length Subnet Masking (VLSM) address plan discrepancies across an enterprise multi-subnet branch network. Diagnose broadcast address host assignment errors, correct default gateway and transit subnet mask mismatches, and verify end-to-end multi-subnet reachability with minimal non-disruptive configuration adjustments.
learning_objectives: Audit an enterprise VLSM address allocation plan against actual router interface and host endpoint configurations
Identify invalid host IP assignments, including directed broadcast and network identifier address misuse
Diagnose and remediate default gateway and inter-router transit subnet mask mismatches
Calculate exact prefix lengths, subnet masks, and usable host ranges to optimize IPv4 address conservation
Verify bidirectional intra-subnet and inter-subnet data plane reachability across routed LAN and WAN boundaries

source.origin: Independently authored enterprise IPv4 VLSM addressing and troubleshooting guide based on RFC 1878 variable length subnetting standards and Cisco IOS routing best practices
